source: Necessarily, every person is self-identical. Therefore, every person is self-identical.

claims.text: If something is necessarily true, then it is true (in all possible worlds, P implies P).
claims.interpretation_note: This implicit premise bridges the modal claim (necessity) to the non-modal conclusion. The source text does not explicitly state this logical principle, but it is required to validate the inference from c1 to c2.

formalization.domain_description: The domain consists of all persons. The argument concerns the property of self-identity among persons.
